ROOT.triggerdef: CREATE TRIGGER CDN.TraNag_LastMod_OFFL ON CDN.TraNag FOR UPDATE AS BEGIN IF UPDATE(TrN_OddDokID) OR UPDATE(TrN_OddZakazPAFA) BEGIN UPDATE CDN.TraNag SET TrN_LastMod = datediff(s,convert(datetime,'1990-01-01',120),getdate()) FROM CDN.TraNag T JOIN inserted I ON T.TrN_GIDNumer = I.TrN_GIDNumer END END
